messages.subject: dependsOnFile
parts:
Hi guys,

  I love the recent fix that errors (instead of aborting) on source-ing files that are syntactically incorrect.

  However, it seems to have degraded 'touch' checking of specified files using the undocumented dependsOnFile call:

lapply(Sys.glob(c("*.R","*.js","js/*.js")),
       shiny:::dependsOnFile)

  Perhaps I'm using it wrong - I'm invoking it in ui.R.

-Alex
